title: Umwami w'Ikirenga wasabye Imana
intro: Umutegetsi ukomeye kandi w’umwirasi yizeraga ko nta n’umwe wari hejuru y’intebe ye. Birukanye itsinda ry’abantu bahungaga bambuka amazi menshi, ariko amaherezo yabo arangira bitangaje. Inkuru y’uyu mwami irasubiramo mu bice byinshi bya Korowani, ikaba umuburo kuri bose.
clues: Nari umutegetsi ukomeye kandi wemeraga ko nta butegetsi burenze ubwanjye mu bihugu nayoboraga.
Nari mfite umujyanama wiringirwa witwaga Haman wamfashije gukora imishinga ikomeye y’ubwubatsi.
Nahamagaye abapfumu beza cyane bo mu gihugu cyanjye kugira ngo bagaragaze ibimenyetso by'intumwa yandwanyije.
Nanze kureka abantu bari abacakara mu bwami bwanjye bakagenda, nubwo hari ibyorezo n'imiburo isobanutse neza.
Nabakurikiye mu nyanja nini hamwe n'ingabo zanjye zose n'amagare yanjye y'intambara.
Iyo nyanja ubwayo yanyihishe hamwe n'ingabo zanjye, iraturoha twese, mu gihe bo bambukaga amahoro.

arabic: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
verse: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy. (51:40)
